question: can ANY currently computable cell be recomputed under a provenance-carrying path with the same value
answer: NO — no cell is currently recomputable
why: recomputation needs two things the corpus does not hold: (1) WHICH frames each cell read — established unrecoverable at A521 in both directions; (2) the derivation that turned frame quantities (scene_linear_peak/mean/percentiles) into GRANULARITY, FWHM and SHEEN — no service was found that names the frame prefixes, so the derivation code is also unlocated.
measure_of_the_loss: this is the depth A532 asked for. It is not that one cell lost its inputs; it is that no published M6 cell can be reproduced from the corpus at all. The numbers are readable and none of them is re-derivable.
A531_scope: the provenance mechanism is specified — every derived quantity records path, family, seed and digest of every frame it reads, in the result artifact, at computation time, as a side effect of computing (A500 lesson). Its BUILD belongs to the next node, per the launcher NEXT NODE section and A533, so that the law and the instrument land together.
